basis: The dashboard is a choropleth map where the caption and legend confirm that darker colors indicate higher incidence values. Visually, the California (CA) polygon is filled with the darkest maroon color on the map, significantly darker than the pale yellow of Tennessee (TN) and the medium orange of Delaware (DE). Based on the routing criterion for the highest-incidence state, California is the correct record to open for priority follow-up.
option_label: Open California (CA) incidence detail for priority follow-up
